structure_recovery.identity_mapping: complex_1/1m = Br = CCDC 2453269; complex_2/2m = Cl = CCDC 2453268. Do not infer complex order from ascending record numbers.
structure_recovery.deterministic_transformation: Read each supplied immutable CIF, verify its internal archive ID, formula and element set before calculation, select the asymmetric unit containing one Cu, one L ligand and one NCS group, preserve atom identities and stereochemistry as deposited, and terminate only the chain bond required to make an isolated monomer; report the atom/bond edit and resulting charge. If a CIF does not match the declared complex identity, report a bounded identity failure and do not alter the file.

state_validation_policy: Check electron-count parity before calculation. Preserve any non-executable source state as a diagnostic failure and keep parity-compatible repaired-state results separate; never relabel a repaired result as the source state.
